items.title: Travel AI’s Prove-It Phase, Visibility, and the Booking Gap
items.snippet: Skift Take: Skift's Data + AI Summit in Europe this week just showed that AI may be changing travel distribution and internal operations, but booking volume is another story. Europe's independent hotels face a new AI visibility problem: travelers are using AI to plan but few are booking through it, and the clearest measurable returns are showing up in operational uses rather than autonomous trip planning.

items.title: Goa CM Pramod Sawant says foreign tourist arrivals will return to pre-COVID levels within a year
items.snippet: Goa officials are optimistic that international tourist arrivals will bounce back to pre-COVID levels within a year. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted initiatives aimed at boosting high-end tourism and enhancing infrastructure.

items.title: WTTC honours Gajendra Shekhawat as India tourism growth accelerates
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) has presented Union Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat with its Global Champion Award, recognising his leadership in supporting the growth, competitiveness and long-term development of India’s tourism sector.

items.title: UP to name Jewar Airport after Narendra Modi
items.snippet: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet on Friday, October 9, 2026, approved a proposal to rename Noida International Airport at Jewar as ‘Narendra Modi International Airport, Noida-Jewar’. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced the decision following the Cabinet meeting, stating that the Council of Ministers had passed a resolution supporting the renaming.

items.title: The War Is Changing the Economics of Saudi Tourism
items.snippet: Skift Take: The war is raising the cost of attracting the international travelers Saudi Arabia needs to meet its tourism ambitions. Photo Caption: Edge of the world, outside Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Delta Air Lines is scheduled to begin nonstop flights from Atlanta to Riyadh on October 23, the first such service by a U.S. airline.

items.title: Bengaluru police conduct late night raids on 400-500 pubs, bars across city
items.snippet: Bengaluru Police Commissioner Seemanth Kumar Singh led a late-night crackdown on pubs and bars across the city, with around 1,500 police personnel conducting raids and inspections at 400 to 500 locations to check violations of operating hours, underage drinking, and other alleged irregularities, he said on Saturday.

items.title: Hilton’s Tempo Set For Europe Debut in Munich, with Rooftop Bar and Arena Next Door
items.snippet: Hilton’s lifestyle brand is expanding into Europe, with its 199-room property set to bring a rooftop bar, gym and café to Munich’s growing entertainment district near the airport.

items.title: Hotel Review: Ark Shoreditch – Co-Working and Karaoke in East London
items.snippet: Recently opened serviced apartment property Ark Shoreditch brings trendy interiors, impressive entertainment facilities, and a brimming events calendar to East London's hospitality scene.

items.title: WTTC & ICCA sign MoU to boost business events
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) and the International Congress and Convention Association (ICCA) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen collaboration between the global Travel & Tourism sector and the international meetings and business events industry. The agreement was signed during WTTC’s 26th Global Summit in Valletta, Malta.

items.title: Accor signs Pullman Udaipur, scheduled to open in 2030
items.snippet: Accor has signed Pullman Udaipur, marking the brand’s entry into the city. Developed in partnership with Kings Luxury Resorts Pvt. Ltd., the 200-key property is scheduled to open in 2030, further expanding Accor’s presence in Rajasthan. The hotel will be located on Airport Road, within the Maharana Pratap Airport corridor, an emerging hospitality and commercial district in Udaipur.
